title: Mini Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Hair Mask
descriptionHtml:
✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Damage✓ Increases Shine✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Hyaluronic Acid
What it is: A hair therapy mask powered by Mirsalehi honey and ceramides for clinically shown intense hydration, strength, and glossy shine without weighing hair down.

Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily

Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick

Hair Concerns:
- Damage, Split Ends, and Breakage
- Dryness
- Shines

Key Benefits:
- Deeply hydrates and nourishes without weighing hair down
- Strengthens and repairs damage
- Quickly delivers a glossy shine

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey and Bee Garden Oil Blend: Intensely nourishes and quickly delivers a glossy shine.
- Biomimetic Ceramides and Panthenol: Repair damage and strengthen.
- Low and High Molecular
How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

- After shampooing squeeze out excess water and apply evenly a generous amount over the lengths and ends of hair. 
- Wait for 5-7 minutes then rinse thoroughly.
- Lightweight enough to use at every wash. 

Pro Tips:
- For extra honey hydration use as an overnight treatment weekly.
- Add even more nourishment by mixing in a few drops of Gisou Honey Infused Hair Oil (sold separately).

Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey and Bee Garden Oil Blend: Intensely nourishes and quickly delivers a glossy shine.
-Biomimetic Ceramides and Panthenol: Repair damage and strengthen.
-Low and High Molecular Weight Hyaluronic Acid: Boosts hydration and locks in moisture.

Aqua (Water/Eau), Cetearyl Alcohol, Behenamidopropyl Dimethylamine, Dicocoylethyl Hydroxyethylmonium Methosulfate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Lactic Acid, Mel (Honey/Miel),* Propolis Cera (Propolis Wax/Cire de Propolis),* Ceramide NP, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Squalane, Tocopherol, Glycerin, Ethylhexylglycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Sunflower Seed Oil Glycerides, Hydrogenated Ethylhexyl Olivate, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Hydrogenated Olive Oil Unsaponifiables, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Sprout Extract, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Caesalpinia Spinosa Fruit Extract, Parfum (Fragrance), Sodium Benzoate, Maltodextrin, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil,** Coumarin,** Hexyl Cinnamal,** Limonene,** Linalool,** Linalyl Acetate,** Yellow 5 (CI 19140), Orange 4 (CI 15510).

*Honey and Propolis sourced from the Mirsalehi Bee Garden.
**Naturally occurring allergens.
